list: The official 55 trophies, names, descriptions and grades as published for PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18. Guides in this file are written for this entry, in our own words, and each one names its sources.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PSN) trophy list: official names, descriptions and grades
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list: grades and the counts PlayStation tracks
PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap: general approach only, paraphrased, never copied
PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy guide: general approach only, paraphrased, never copied

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies on this list are earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt. Use the roadmap view in this tracker — story first, then strands and activities, then the long counters — and let this one arrive last.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies on the official list
The platinum pops automatically when the set is complete
sources: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — trophy list (platinum, 54 trophies beneath it)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission named in the official description. Simply start the story and play it through to the mission-complete screen; nothing else on the list can be earned before this one, and it cannot be skipped.
steps: Start the story campaign
Play Gone Fishing through to completion
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. Keep following the main mission markers after the opening mission and this unlocks at the chapter break; no side content is required for it.
steps: Continue the main story after Gone Fishing
Reach the end of Chapter 1
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story; the name is shown exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Story progress alone earns it — keep clearing main missions until the chapter closes.
steps: Finish Chapter 1 first
Play the main missions through the end of Chapter 2
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story. As with the other chapter trophies this is pure story progression: follow the main markers, and it unlocks when the chapter ends.
steps: Finish Chapter 2 first
Play the main missions through the end of Chapter 3

Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story. Keep the campaign moving; by this point the strand and activity trophies are also open, but none of them are needed for this one.
steps: Finish Chapter 3 first
Play the main missions through the end of Chapter 4
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story — the gold that closes the campaign. Before starting it, keep a separate manual save: the choice-based trophies lower down this list are the ones a late save protects, and the official list does not say whether missions can be replayed afterwards.
steps: Finish every chapter of the story
Make a backup save before the final mission, then complete it
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap (backup-save habit, paraphrased)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run, named in the official description. It sits on the main path, so ordinary story progress earns it; if you are hunting it specifically, check which chapter you are in from the roadmap view.
steps: Progress the main story
Complete the mission Breakfast Run
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a named story mission. Play the campaign until the heist appears on the main path and finish it; the trophy is for completing the mission, not for any particular take or approach, as far as the official description states.
steps: Progress the main story
Complete the mission The Cartel Heist
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It is part of the main campaign, so it unlocks through normal story progress; no collectible or activity work feeds into it.
steps: Progress the main story
Complete the mission Child's Play

steps: Progress the main story
Complete the mission Headliners

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A main-path mission: play the campaign to the takedown and finish it. The separate VCIA trophy lower down the list (Catch Me If You Can) is a free-roam action at the same authority, not this mission.
steps: Progress the main story
Complete the mission VCIA Takedown

steps: Progress the main story
Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion on the game's own completion counter — the second gold, and the long pole of the platinum. Work the whole list: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and counters all feed the percentage, so use this tracker to find what is left when the counter stalls below 100. The official description does not publish the checklist behind the counter, so we do not invent one here.
steps: Finish the story and every stranger strand
Clear activities and collectibles until the in-game counter reads 100%
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap (100% as the long-term goal, paraphrased)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts, one of the big counters on the list. Stunts are the game's marked jump and thrill spots; work them region by region as you explore, rather than in one sitting, and let the counter build alongside The Goodtime State. The official list gives the number but not the spots, so no locations are claimed here.
steps: Attempt stunt spots whenever you pass one while exploring
Keep a region-by-region sweep going until the counter reaches 250
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy guide (counter trophies as long-term sweeps, paraphrased)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The cheapest trophy on the list if you sample as you go: whenever the map offers a new kind of activity — a race, a range, a game, a challenge — do one round of it instead of walking past, and this unlocks without a dedicated session.
steps: Start one round of every activity type the game offers
Repeat until every type has been tried at least once
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — PlayStation's tracked count for this one is 42 challenges, as the kit's notes on the official list record. Learn each range's target pattern at bronze pace first, then chase golds one range at a time; accuracy medals usually reward a slower, cleaner run over a fast sloppy one, but the official list does not publish the medal thresholds.
steps: Unlock and attempt every Shooting Range challenge (42 tracked)
Replay each challenge until its medal is gold
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PSNProfiles — trophy list (tracked count for the range challenges)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap (medal-chasing approach, paraphrased)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Winning once per location is the requirement, not winning everywhere in one streak, so clear the locations as you unlock new areas and revisit any race you lose with a fresh run.
steps: Find each Top Fun Drone Race location as areas open up
Win one race at every location
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different is the operative word in the official description, so replaying one easy race twenty times does not count. Spread your wins across the race calendar as new events open, and keep a note here of which ones are already banked.
steps: Enter races across different events and locations
Win 20 distinct races
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, learn its scoring on a first attempt, then beat his mark on a repeat run — challenges like this are built to be retried, and the official description asks for a win, not a first-try win.
steps: Unlock and start Cal's fishing challenge
Beat Cal's score in a challenge run
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — one full game, start to finish, on any arcade cabinet you find. Pick the shortest game on offer if you are clearing it for the list; completion, not a high score, is what the official description asks for.
steps: Find an arcade game in the world
Play one game through to completion
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — the end of Andy's strand of side missions. Strands open as you meet their givers during the story; work Andy's chain whenever it is offered and this unlocks at its last job. It also feeds Strangers & Freaks and the 100% counter.
steps: Meet Andy and start his mission strand
Complete his missions through the final one
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy guide (strand trophies as chain completions, paraphrased)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton — the end of Kenton's strand. Start his chain when he appears, keep returning between story chapters, and finish his last job; strands left untouched until the endgame are the usual reason this one is missing.
steps: Meet Kenton and start his mission strand
Complete his missions through the final one
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy guide (strand trophies as chain completions, paraphrased)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy — the end of Billy's strand. Work his jobs as they are offered rather than saving the whole strand for the end, and the trophy unlocks at the chain's final mission.
steps: Meet Billy and start his mission strand
Complete his missions through the final one

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida — the silver that sits above the individual strand trophies. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each contribute a strand named elsewhere on this list, so finishing those five puts you most of the way; pick up every other stranger strand you meet to reach eight.
steps: Complete the named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone)
Finish any other stranger strands until 8 are complete
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap (strand counting, paraphrased)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy — the end of Randy's strand. Start his chain when he appears, work it between chapters, and finish the last job for the trophy and another strand toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Meet Randy and start his mission strand
Complete his missions through the final one
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy guide (strand trophies as chain completions, paraphrased)

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone — the end of Tyrone's strand. As with the other named strands, the trophy is for finishing the whole chain, not a single job, so keep returning until his final mission is done.
steps: Meet Tyrone and start his mission strand
Complete his missions through the final one
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy guide (strand trophies as chain completions, paraphrased)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — a collectible-style sweep: the requirement is every spot, so the last few are the work. Sweep region by region while exploring for The Goodtime State, and mark regions off here as you clear them. The official list does not publish the spots, so no locations are claimed in this guide.
steps: Meditate at each spot you find while exploring a region
Sweep the remaining regions until every spot is used
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy guide (every-spot trophies as region sweeps, paraphrased)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunt when it is offered and track the specific animal it names; a unique animal is a one-of-a-kind target rather than ordinary wildlife, so follow the hunt's own tracking prompts instead of hunting at random. The official description does not name the animal or its ground, so neither does this guide.
steps: Accept Bret's hunt
Track and hunt the unique animal it names
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — a silver for collectors. Cards are found in the world; complete whole sets rather than scattering pickups, and keep the sets you are closest to finishing as your sweep priority. The official list counts sets, not loose cards, and does not publish card locations, so none are claimed here.
steps: Collect cards whenever you find them while exploring
Finish any 3 complete card sets
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap (collectible sets as sweeps, paraphrased)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — a silver counter built on a repeated world interaction. Treat it like the meditation spots: use every valid location you pass, sweep region by region, and expect the last locations, not the first fifty, to take the time. The official list gives the count but not the locations.
steps: Use the interaction at every valid location you come across
Sweep region by region until the counter reaches 100
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy guide (location counters as region sweeps, paraphrased)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges accumulate across the whole game, so this is a breadth trophy: take challenges as they appear instead of farming one type, and it should land naturally on the road to 100% — check it again only if you reach the endgame short of fifty.
steps: Complete challenges as they appear in every mode of play
Reach 50 completed challenges
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. This is a partner trophy: raise your wanted level to four stars while partnered, then break line of sight and stay hidden together until the stars clear — escaping, not outrunning, is what the official description asks for. Coordinate the hiding phase; a partner who keeps shooting restarts the heat.
steps: Partner up and raise the Wanted Level to 4 stars
Break away together and stay out of sight until the level is lost
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level — the chain is the difficulty: three robberies in one continuous wanted run, with your partner. Plan the three shops close together before starting, keep moving between them so the wanted level never drops, and do not split up. Retryable if the chain breaks; nothing in the official description makes it one-chance.
steps: Partner up and pick 3 shops close together
Rob all 3 in one run without the Wanted Level clearing
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovery counters like this usually credit each distinct vehicle you enter or encounter, so make a habit of getting into unfamiliar cars, bikes and boats instead of always returning to your own garage — the count builds fastest early, when most of the traffic is new to you.
steps: Enter or register unfamiliar vehicles whenever you see them
Reach 100 discovered vehicles
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set the attempt up rather than hoping for it: pick a fight with at least five enemies in one area, position before you trigger Combat Focus, and work the group in a single activation. If a run ends at four, reposition and try the next group — it is a setup trophy, not a luck trophy.
steps: Find a group of at least 5 enemies
Trigger Combat Focus once and take down 5 before it ends
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap (single-use multi-kill setup, paraphrased)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, leave the airport the unofficial way: get airborne (or out) without following the scheduled, permitted route. Head to VCIA in free roam with access to an aircraft and depart outside any mission or scheduled flight. The official description is a joke at the player's expense and gives no method, so treat the exact trigger as unconfirmed and experiment at the airport itself.
steps: Go to VCIA in free roam with an aircraft available
Depart without using a scheduled or mission route
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — points at the Rhino tank: get into a Rhino and make heat in it, most plausibly by raising a wanted level while driving one. Because the wording is deliberately vague, this guide claims no exact threshold: take a Rhino on a rampage, survive the response, and see whether it pops; if a guide site later pins the exact condition, it will be for time or stars survived in the tank.
steps: Get into a Rhino tank
Raise and survive a wanted response while in it
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery, start to finish: no alarm, no witnesses raising the heat. Scout the store first, plan your exit before you act, and restart the attempt if you are spotted; a detected run earns money but not the trophy. The official description does not name a store, so any jewelry store robbery done cleanly should be the target.
steps: Enter a jewelry store and rob it quietly
Leave without ever being detected
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — five separate vault robberies, each ending in a clean getaway; a robbery you are caught after does not read as 'and escape' in the official wording. Build a repeatable routine: same entry, same exit route, lose the heat, then move to the next vault.
steps: Rob a bank vault and escape the response
Repeat at 5 vaults in total
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy guide (rob-and-escape series, paraphrased)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop or open the truck, take what it carries, and then lose the response — the escape is part of the requirement in the official wording, so plan the getaway before you make the stop, not after.
steps: Find and rob an armored truck
Escape the response with the take
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — uncover the whole map. Exploration trophies credit regions visited, not roads driven, so when the counter stalls, look for the pockets you never entered: outlying islands, interiors and the far corners of the state. Pair the sweep with the meditation spots, WAiNK locations and stunt spots so one tour feeds four trophies.
steps: Visit every region of the state as the story opens it
Sweep any unvisited pockets until all of Leonida is explored
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap (exploration as a combined sweep, paraphrased)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one robbery per gang, so variety is the requirement, not repetition. Keep a list of which gangs you have already hit; operations belonging to a gang you have cleared do not advance this one. The official list does not name the gangs or their operations, so none are listed here.
steps: Rob an illegal operation of the first gang you find
Repeat for an operation of every other gang
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — one of the list's quiet moment trophies: go to Ocean Beach, order or pick up a cocktail where drinks are served, and take in the view. If it does not pop on the first sip, stay for the full drinking animation and the view; moment trophies usually trigger on the completed interaction, not on entering the area.
steps: Travel to Ocean Beach
Have a cocktail there and take in the view
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive through the showroom glass from inside, in a car, rather than using the door. Get into a vehicle inside a showroom (or drive one in), line up with the window frontage, and accelerate out through it. 'Classic style' is the series' long-running joke about exactly this exit; the official description gives no showroom, so any showroom exit through the glass is the attempt.
steps: Get into a car inside a vehicle showroom
Accelerate out through the showroom glass
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — visit the named bowling alley and complete its bowling interaction: play a game (or the follow-through action the alley offers) rather than just walking in. The official description names the place but not the exact action, so do the full activity on offer there; Ten Pin, lower down the list, is a separate driving trophy and not this one.
steps: Travel to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley
Play the bowling activity there through to the end
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is deliberately cryptic, and this guide will not invent a method for it. It sits among the partner trophies on the list (Hot Together, Retail Therapy), so the working reading is a partner activity performed in public or at scale: try partner activities in crowded places and watch for it. If a guide site pins the trigger, expect it to be a specific partner interaction — until then, treat this as the list's one genuinely unconfirmed trophy.
steps: Play partner activities, especially in public or crowded settings
Watch for the unlock; no confirmed method exists in the official list
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Potentially missable — flagged from the official description alone: 'Choices made (for better or worse)' reads as a trophy tied to story choices, and choices are the one thing a single playthrough cannot take back. Protect yourself cheaply: keep rotating manual saves before big story decisions, so a choice-locked outcome can be revisited without a full replay. Whether it truly can be missed is not confirmed in the official list; the backup-save habit costs nothing either way.
steps: Keep a manual save before major story choices
Make the choices the story offers and finish the relevant mission
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap (backup saves before choices, paraphrased)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Potentially missable — flagged from the official wording alone: 'Second time's the charm' implies a first attempt that goes wrong and a second that lands, which usually means failing or retrying a specific story beat. If a mission or event clearly goes badly the first time by design, do not reload to 'fix' it — play on and take the second chance the game offers. Not confirmed as missable in the official list; the warning is to let scripted failures happen, not to avoid them.
steps: Let a scripted first attempt fail where the story forces one
Succeed on the second attempt it offers
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The official description — 'What the hell just happened?' — is the list's secret-encounter trophy: something strange has to happen to you in the world. Guides cannot honestly pin a location from that wording, and this one does not try; explore off the beaten path, especially at night and away from the city, and investigate anything out of place. Treat any specific spot claimed without a source as a rumour, not a step.
steps: Explore remote areas, including at night
Investigate strange encounters until the event triggers
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock down a group of pedestrians with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, the bowling image being a cluster bowled over in one pass. Line up a tight group on a pavement, ride or drive past at moderate speed, and swing as you pass through them; one clean pass through a group is the attempt, and it is freely retryable.
steps: Find a tight group of pedestrians
Pass through them at speed while landing a melee attack
sources: Official trophy description (Exophase / PSNProfiles list)
Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — a money counter with a specific channel: only Marked Bills laundered through contacts count, not general earnings. Feed every batch of marked bills you pick up through your contacts as you play, rather than saving them for one session, and the quarter-million accumulates alongside the story.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and jobs

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — a cumulative spending counter, and 'across all shops' means the total is pooled, so ordinary play gets most of it: buy vehicles, clothes, weapons and services as you normally would, and check the counter late in the game. If you finish the story short, spend the remainder on garage stock rather than starting a new earner.

Reach $100,000 total spent

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — every garage on the property market, which makes this an earner trophy in disguise: you need the cash for all of them, so it pairs with Dime on the Dollar and Treat Yo Self in the money phase of the roadmap. Buy garages as they become affordable and sweep the last ones once the story income is in. The official list does not publish the property list or prices, so none are claimed here.
